messages:
ben (TitanOps): Quick shot - onboarding POC blocked: SSO TXT validation times out and SCIM group mappings unclear. Need a short plan to get unblocked.

maya (Sales): Thanks Ben. Oscar will triage. Which DNS provider and exact TXT you added?

ben (TitanOps): Provider: NameWave. Added `_redwood-verify.titan.example TXT "rv=yy8k"` TTL=60. dig from our infra returns it; public resolvers do not.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Likely resolver anycast divergence. Workarounds: 1) add same TXT at apex and lower TTL, or 2) provide signed SAML metadata from your IdP for short-term proof. Which prefer?

ben (TitanOps): We'll try apex TXT first. Also SCIM: can we map groups `eng-*` -> dev and `sec-*` -> admin and support incremental PATCH only?

oscar (Solutions Eng): Yes to both. We support regex group mapping and PATCH. For POC we can temporarily raise SCIM rate limits for 14 days - send estimated group sizes.

nora (Security): Security checklist: persistent NameID recommended for linking, audit log retention request noted (hosted=90d default), SCIM over TLS required. If you need 12+ months retention we export to your S3 and require a DPA addendum.

ben (TitanOps): Compliance wants 12 months and persistent NameID. Also want an IdP failover plan for outages.

liam (Account Exec): Commercial: we can enable a 21-day Dedicated evaluation (discounted) to test-throughput and failover. I'll add to the POC terms once SE confirms throughput needs.

oscar (Solutions Eng): Failover options: cached session fallback, secondary SAML IdP (hot standby), or emergency service account tokens (requires approval). We'll demo secondary IdP + cached sessions.

legalbot: Auto: DPA addendum required for >90d retention/export. Maya to route.

maya (Sales): Next steps: 1) Ben to add apex TXT or upload signed metadata, 2) Ben to list group sizes, 3) SE to bump SCIM rate limits for 14d and prepare SAML metadata template, 4) AE/legal to circulate DPA addendum. I'll schedule a 30-min sync.

ben (TitanOps): Thanks all - adding apex TXT now and will post dig outputs.
